summary: The end obsidian platform resets every time entities go through the end portal, which can cause blocks to be deleted
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter the End by using an end portal.
2. Place blocks on top of and around the obsidian platform where you spawn.
3. Take note of the blocks you placed.
4. Run `/kill`.
5. Enter the End again using an end portal.
6. Observe that the obsidian platform has reset and that blocks previously placed on or around it have been deleted.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.4.2, 1.14.4, 1.16.1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.4, 20w45a, 20w46a, 20w48a, 20w49a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05a, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w17a, 21w20a, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1, 21w39a, 21w42a, 1.18, 1.18.1, 22w05a, 1.18.2 Pre-release 1, 1.18.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.18.2, 22w14a, 1.19 Pre-release 4, 1.19 Pre-release 5, 1.19 Release Candidate 1, 1.19 Release Candidate 2, 1.19, 22w24a, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 1.19.3, 23w03a, 23w04a, 23w05a, 1.19.4, 1.20 Release Candidate 1, 1.20, 1.20.1, 24w11a, 1.20.6 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
When an entity enters the End through an End portal, the game regenerates the obsidian spawn platform at the End spawn position. This regeneration replaces the platform blocks and clears the surrounding space above it, regardless of whether the platform has been modified since the previous visit.

As a result, any player-placed blocks within the platform’s regeneration area are removed each time the platform is regenerated. This includes block entities such as chests and shulker boxes; if they are inside the affected area, the containers and their contents are deleted. Blocks outside the regeneration area are unaffected.
Expected Behavior: Blocks placed on or around the End obsidian platform should remain in place when entities travel through the End portal. The platform should not be regenerated in a way that removes existing blocks, including chests and shulker boxes, and any containers in the affected area should retain their contents after the entity returns to the End.
